get.summary: Cheap reachability check used by the POS to decide whether the cloud is available.
Every visible category and its available items, for the POS to render.
Every category and item, including hidden and unavailable ones, for management tooling.

delete.summary: Soft-deletes a menu item. Past orders keep their own snapshot of its name and price.

put.summary: Sets a menu item's description and declared allergens (CAT-02).

post.summary: Uploads (or replaces) a menu item's photo (CAT-02). JPEG/PNG/WebP, 5MB max.

delete.summary: Removes a menu item's photo, if one is set (CAT-02).

post.summary: Bulk-creates menu items from a CSV file (CAT-17).
Bulk-creates menu items from an Excel (.xlsx) file (CAT-17). Same columns and per-row behaviour as the CSV import.

put.summary: 86's a menu item, or brings it back (CAT-13).
Changes a menu item's price for future orders. Past order lines keep their own snapshot.
Sets or clears a menu item's separate takeaway price (CAT-06). Null falls back to the dine-in price.
Sets or clears which course a menu item is served at (CAT-14).
Sets or clears which kitchen station prepares a menu item (CAT-15).
Sets or clears a menu item's recurring day/time availability window (CAT-11).
Marks or unmarks a menu item as couvert (CAT-12).
Sets or clears a menu item's pending future price change (CAT-16).
Hides a whole category (and every item under it) from GET /menu, or shows it again (CAT-01).

get.summary: Every room and its tables, with current state, for the POS to render as a table picker.

post.summary: Marks a dirty table cleared and free for the next party.
Flags that the table has asked for the bill (FLR-04) — a floor-plan signal for staff, separate from actually previewing the bill (ORD-18/19).
Adds a table to a room (FLR-03).

put.summary: Edits a table's label, seats, shape or position (FLR-03).

delete.summary: Removes a table from the floor plan. Requires the table to be free (FLR-03).

post.summary: Creates a room (FLR-03's room-CRUD follow-up).

put.summary: Renames or reorders a room (FLR-03's room-CRUD follow-up).

delete.summary: Removes a room. Requires it to have no tables (FLR-03's room-CRUD follow-up).

put.summary: Assigns or clears which waiter is working a room as their section (FLR-06).

post.summary: Pushes 2+ free tables together into one seating group for a large party (FLR-05).

delete.summary: Un-groups every table in a seating group, freeing them to be seated individually again (FLR-05).

post.summary: Creates an organization — the top of the Organization/Site/Terminal hierarchy (IDN-01).

get.summary: Lists every organization for the current tenant.

post.summary: Creates a site (a physical restaurant location) under an organization (IDN-01).

get.summary: Lists every site under an organization.

post.summary: Registers a terminal (a physical POS device) at a site (IDN-01). No pairing/auth yet.

get.summary: Lists every terminal registered at a site.

post.summary: Creates a staff member with an initial PIN at a site (IDN-08/09).

get.summary: Lists every staff member at a site.

post.summary: Verifies a staff member's PIN. Locks the account out after 5 consecutive incorrect PINs.

put.summary: Sets a staff member's PIN, clearing any lockout — an admin reset, not a self-service change.
Creates or updates a feature flag for the tenant, optionally scoped to one platform (IDN-16).

get.summary: Lists every feature flag configured for the tenant.
Resolves whether a flag is enabled for a platform: a platform-specific row wins, falling back to the "all platforms" row, defaulting to disabled if neither is configured.

post.summary: Creates an empty price list for a site (CAT-05).

get.summary: Gets a price list and every entry it currently holds.
Lists every price list for a site.

post.summary: Adds a price override for one menu item to a price list. Rejects a second entry for the same item.

get.summary: Resolves the price an item currently charges under a price list — the list's own override, or the item's ordinary price when none is set.

post.summary: Creates an empty combo (CAT-10) — a fixed-price bundle of menu items.

get.summary: Lists every combo for the current tenant.
Gets a combo and every component it currently holds.

post.summary: Adds one component item to a combo. Rejects a second entry for the same item.
Adds an effective-dated VAT rate for one (alcohol band, channel, region) combination (CAT-07).

get.summary: Lists every tax rule on file.
Resolves the VAT rate in force for a combination at an instant (CAT-08). Defaults to now.

post.summary: Opens a table.

get.summary: Order history/search — filter by status, table and opened-date range (ORD-22).

post.summary: Opens a takeaway/counter-sale order — no Floor table involved (ORD-20).

get.summary: Current state of an order.

post.summary: Rings up a menu item onto an open order.
Rings a combo up onto an open order (CAT-10), one ordinary line per component at its own VAT rate.

put.summary: Sets or clears a line's free-text kitchen note (ORD-06).
Changes how many of a line's item were ordered (ORD-03).
Sets or clears a percentage/fixed discount on one line (ORD-11).

post.summary: Voids a line, with a required reason (ORD-10).
Sends unfired lines to the kitchen (ORD-07/08) — one course, or everything still pending.

put.summary: Sets or clears a percentage/fixed discount on the whole order (ORD-11).

post.summary: Moves an open order to a different table (ORD-12).
Moves a single line onto a different open order (ORD-13).
Merges another open order's lines into this one and frees its table (ORD-14).

get.summary: Computes an even split of the current total, without changing order state.

post.summary: Previews a bill split by item (ORD-16), without changing order state.

get.summary: Previews a bill split proportionally by covers per group (ORD-17), without changing order state.
Pre-bill preview for the table — a documento não fiscal, not an invoice. Safe to call repeatedly.

post.summary: Closes the order and issues its fiscal document.

Records a cash or card tender against an order's remaining balance, computing change (PAY-01/02/03) — a card tender cannot exceed the balance, since a TPA has no change to give back. A tender smaller than what's owed is a valid partial payment (PAY-05); splitting one payment across several methods at once is still PAY-04. An optional tip, attributed to a staff member or left unattributed, rides along on the same payment (PAY-06).

get.summary: Lists every payment recorded against an order, oldest first.
Minimum/recommended version and sunset date for the calling client (API-07).
